subject: general
question: Which of the following steps can the government take to move towards sustainable use of natural resources?

options.text: Making the study of environmental science compulsory
Creation of metro and bus services

solution:
The correct answer is __**Creation of the metro and bus services**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The creation of metro and bus services can play a crucial role in the **sustainable use of natural resources** because:
 
• **Reduced dependence on personal vehicles**:
 
 
• **Public transport systems like metro and buses help reduce the number of private vehicles on the road, **which can lead to lower fuel consumption and reduced emissions, contributing to energy conservation and air quality improvement.
 
 
 
• **Energy efficiency**:
 
 
• Trains and buses are **more energy-efficient per passenger than individual cars or motorcycles.**
 
 
 
• **Reduction in resource use**:
 
 
• More public transportation **reduces the demand for resources like fuel and minimizes the environmental impact of transportation.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sustainable use of natural resources** refers to utilizing natural resources in a way that meets the needs of the present generation without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.
 
• It **involves managing resources in a manner that ensures their availability over the long term while minimizing negative environmental impacts.**
 
• This concept is vital for maintaining the balance of ecosystems and ensuring that resources are not depleted or degraded.
